description: Request flows from CAT through the API Gateway and then sequentially to TDH, SEL, and ST. Failure at any stage breaks the entire flow.

on_failure.reason: Gateway failure blocks all downstream services
TDH failure stops sequential execution, SEL and ST are never invoked
SEL failure prevents ST from being called
Final dependency failure, no further downstream steps

success_condition: All steps (GATEWAY → TDH → SEL → ST) must return success for bin_outcome to be SUCCESS
failure_condition: Any step failure stops execution and marks bin_outcome as FAILURE
